description: Cline implements Studio Agent API v1 for global and scoped single chat. Host requests, outputs and identity are defined in sdk/src/agents.ts. Native model choices and approvals are ACP session state.

empty.description: Omit the request input to receive the current command.

loginCommand.description: Interactive native login command for the activating Studio account and Profile.

command.description: Shell-quoted Cline auth invocation. Empty if the engine is not installed.

native-login.description: Read the command for the selected external or Studio-managed native Cline engine. Returns no credentials.
